notes:
Background: mid-market SaaS for customer lifecycle automation. Building threaded chat agents that interface with internal CRMs and order tools. Team is product-led with rapid release cadence.

Discovery summary:
- Product leads (CTO + VP Product) care about UX: streaming first-token <1.5s for chat feels critical.
- Want tool-calling support (order lookup, ticket create, escalate to human via webhook).
- Primary concern: predictable latency during peak (weekday M-F 09:00-18:00 PST).
- Data residency ok in US, but want VPC/private peering for Dedicated later.
- Cost sensitive but willing to commit for guaranteed latency at scale.

Quote from demo: "The agent must return a streaming token within 1.2s on typical queries — users abandon after 1.5s." — VP Product

Security: asked for SOC2 attestation, SSO + SCIM, audit logs, and KMS integration. Legal pushed NDA and standard DPA clauses.

POC wishes: 2-week hosted API POC (streaming enabled) integrated with 3 internal flows + stress test at 200 concurrent chat sessions. Baseline metric: 90th pct first-token <1.5s, p99 <2.2s. Also evaluate fallback to smaller quantized model under load.

References: pricing request sent 2026-02-18 (see drive deck). Security intake started 2026-02-25 (ticket INF-4921).

use_case_summary: Customer support chat agents with streaming responses and tool/function calling for account lookups and ticket operations. Will start on Hosted API to validate latency SLOs and then evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC peering. Target: <1.5s first-token for typical queries, support streaming + webhook tool calls, maintain audit logs.
technical_requirements: KV cache/prefix caching desired to reduce latency for repeat flows
Autoscaling for weekday peak (200 concurrent sessions target)
Model preferences: open models preferred; willing to use Redwood-verified variants and quantized options
Fallbacks: automatic routing to smaller model or degraded mode with plain text when capacity constrained
poc_plan: Two-week Hosted API POC: integrate streaming chat endpoint into 3 pilot flows (billing, order status, basic troubleshooting). Run synthetic latency harness (scripted chats) and 2-hour stress window at 200 concurrents. Success criteria: 90th pct first-token <1.5s and no functional regressions on tool-calling. Deliverable: POC report with latency distribution and cost estimate for Dedicated sizing.
pricing_expectations: Mid-market pricing band. Interested in committed monthly reserved capacity if Hosted API POC meets latency targets. Looking for clear unit pricing for streaming tokens + per-connection burst pricing. Budget signals: $10k-$20k/mo initial, scale to $15k-$40k with Dedicated commit.
demo_feedback: Positive on streaming UX and tool-calling demo. Asked for deeper tests on tail latency and an example of graceful fallback during load. SE to provide kernel/quantization notes and expected token costs for sample flows.
